;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Former [[Hurricane Eta]], now a tropical depression, moves toward [[Cuba]] after regaining strength. The government of [[the Bahamas]] issues a tropical storm watch while a state of emergency is declared in [[Miami-Dade County, Florida]], as the state also prepares for the impact of the storm. The storm left at least 100 people dead in Central America. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/06/us/tropical-depression-eta-friday/index.html (CNN)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]]
*****[[Illinois]] reports 12,348 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. This brings the cumulative cases total to 477,978. [https://chicago.cbslocal.com/2020/11/07/coronavirus-in-illinois-state-reports-record-breaking-12438-new-confirmed-cases-including-76-additional-deaths/ (WBBM-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Missouri]]
*****[[Missouri]] reports 4,559 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. This is because the state "de-duplicates" individuals who have already received a test prior to the 7-day period. [https://www.komu.com/news/saturday-covid-19-coverage-missouri-sees-a-4-559-case-increase-since-friday/article_93e34560-2111-11eb-a87a-1f6eb26a3149.html (KOMU-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] records 6,225 new cases, a new single-day record. [https://www.mlive.com/coronavirus/2020/11/michigan-records-a-new-one-day-high-of-6225-coronavirus-cases.html (MLive.com)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Alberta]] reports 919 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/alberta-covid-record-1.5794253 (CBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports 1,132 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of cases in the [[Provinces and territories of Canada|province]] to 82,825. It is the largest single-day increase in cases since the pandemic began. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7448760/ontario-coronavirus-cases-nov-7-covid19/ (Global News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] reports a record 8,421 new infections in the past 24 hours, raising its nationwide case total to 147,220. [https://mobil.krone.at/2270567 (''Kronen Zeitung'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bosnia and Herzegovina]]
****[[Prime Minister of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Prime Minister]] [[Zoran Tegeltija]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-bosnia-tegeltija/bosnian-prime-minister-tegeltija-tests-positive-for-covid-19-statement-idUSKBN27N0DH (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports a new record of 86,852 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours while the total COVID-19 deaths surpasses 40,000 as [[Prime Minister of France|Prime Minister]] [[Jean Castex]] warns that the second wave has "brutally" and "violently" arrived in the country. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-france-breaks-daily-cases-record-for-third-day-as-deaths-top-40-000-12127211 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****The number of daily confirmed cases in [[Germany]] hits a new record of 23,399 over the last 24 hours, according to data released by the [[Robert Koch Institute]], bringing the nationwide total to 642,488. It is the third consecutive day that the country reported a record number of daily cases. [https://www.brusselstimes.com/news/world-all-news/139577/covid-19-germany-coronavirus-infections-rise-robert-koch-institute/ (''The Brussels Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a new record of 39,811 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total to 902,490 cases. [[Lombardy]] remained the hardest hit region, reporting 11,489 new cases. [https://www.corriere.it/salute/20_novembre_07/coronavirus-italia-bollettino-oggi-7-novembre-39811-nuovi-casi-425-morti-28f8b14a-2102-11eb-8b53-82a05f6b5eae.shtml?refresh_ce-cp (''Corriere della Sera'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] reports a record 107 new fatalities in a single day, bringing the nationwide death toll to 2,357 while the country also surpasses 100,000 confirmed cases of [[COVID-19]] after a record 5,318 cases were reported. [https://hungarytoday.hu/coronavirus-hungary-breaks-daily-record-with-over-5000-new-cases/ (Hungary Today)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] surpasses 500,000 cases of COVID-19 after a record 27,875 new cases are reported in the past 24 hours. [https://sanok.naszemiasto.pl/koronawirus-27875-zakazen-w-polsce-1946-na-podkarpaciu-48-w/ar/c1-7629359 (Sanok Naszemiasto)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reports a new record of 10,746 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total to 450,934 cases. [https://112.international/society/ukraine-claims-new-anti-record-of-covid-19-cases-over-day-10746-56287.html (112 International)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia (country)|COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia]]
****[[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] announces a curfew in [[Tbilisi]], [[Kutaisi]], [[Batumi]], [[Rustavi]], [[Zugdidi]], [[Gori, Georgia|Gori]] and [[Poti]] between 10:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. local time beginning November 9, amid a surge in COVID-19 cases. [https://agenda.ge/en/news/2020/3517 (Agenda.ge)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports a single-day record of 9,450 new cases in the last 24 hours, prompting [[President of Iran|President]] [[Hassan Rouhani]] to announce new restrictions that all non-essential businesses must close at 6:00 p.m. local time for a month starting November 10. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20201107-iran-daily-virus-infections-exceed-9-000 (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] reports 1,502 new cases in the last 24 hours, the highest single-day total since July 30, pushing the cumulative infections total to 341,753 cases. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/pakistan-hits-new-daily-high-of-virus-cases-in-3-months/2035177 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
***The number of daily confirmed cases in [[Morocco]] surges by a record 5,836 cases, bringing the nationwide total to 252,185. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2020/11/325172/morocco-confirms-record-breaking-5836-new-covid-19-cases-in-24-hours/ (''Morocco World News'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2020 Ivorian presidential election]]
**Police arrest opposition leader and former prime minister [[Pascal Affi N'Guessan]] for creating a parallel government after the victory of incumbent [[Alassane Ouattara]] in the election. Prosecutors are seeking terrorism charges against more than a dozen opposition leaders who boycotted the election and created a transitional council. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ivorycoast-election/ivory-coast-opposition-leader-arrested-for-creating-rival-government-idUSKBN27N0AO?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Human rights in the United Arab Emirates]]
**The [[United Arab Emirates]] overhauls its legal system to loosen restrictions on alcohol consumption, permit [[cohabitation]], and criminalize [[honor killing]]s, among other changes. [https://apnews.com/article/dubai-united-arab-emirates-honor-killings-travel-islam-bce74c423897dc77c7beb72e4f51a23a (AP)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]]
**All [[News media in the United States|major U.S. networks]] [[decision desk|project]] that [[Joe Biden]] has been [[President-elect of the United States|elected]] [[President of the United States]] after winning [[2020 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania|Pennsylvania]]. [[Kamala Harris]] [[Vice President–elect of the United States|will]] become the first female [[Vice President of the United States]]. This marks the first time since [[1992 United States presidential election|1992]] that an incumbent president's challenger has won the election over the incumbent president, when [[Bill Clinton]] defeated [[George H. W. Bush]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/11/07/politics/joe-biden-wins-us-presidential-election/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.businessinsider.com/trump-join-10-presidents-who-didnt-win-reelection-2020-10#george-hw-bush-1989-1993-10 (''Business Insider'')]
**President [[Donald Trump]] is refusing to [[Concession (politics)|concede]] to Biden and has vowed to [[Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election|challenge]] the results [[Post-election lawsuits related to the 2020 U.S. presidential election|in court]], alleging widespread [[electoral fraud]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2020/11/08/us/trump-biden (''The New York Times'')] 
**[[Fiji]]an [[Prime Minister of Fiji|Prime Minister]] [[Frank Bainimarama]] is the first leader to congratulate [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries|Democratic presidential nominee]] [[Joe Biden]], despite no official result being announced at the time. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/430102/fiji-pm-congratulates-joe-biden-despite-no-official-result-in-us-election (RNZ)] [https://amp.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2020/nov/06/us-election-joe-biden-donald-trump-result-latest-who-is-winning-live-2020-updates (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2020 Egyptian parliamentary election]]
**After a first round in October, voters in [[Egypt]] head once again to the polls to elect their members of [[Parliament of Egypt|parliament]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/7/egypt-holds-second-stage-of-parliamentary-election (Al Jazeera)]

;Sports
*[[2020 Breeders' Cup]]
**In [[horse racing]], American [[thoroughbred]] racehorse [[Authentic (racehorse)|Authentic]] wins [[2020 Breeders' Cup Classic|the]] [[Breeders' Cup]] [[Breeders' Cup Classic|Classic]] at the [[Keeneland]] racetrack in [[Lexington, Kentucky|Lexington]], [[Kentucky]], U.S, which was held with limited spectators due to the COVID-19 pandemic. [https://www.cbc.ca/sports/authentic-breeders-cup-classic-1.5794322 (CBC)] [https://www.bloodhorse.com/horse-racing/articles/244613/authentic-wires-field-to-win-breeders-cup-classic (''The Blood-Horse'')]
